verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a publishable, hosted Trust Center with custom domain and branding. Visitors can self-serve or request sensitive security documents, and admins approve or deny requests and enforce an NDA. Admins can also choose what content to show or hide. missing for 10: explicit evidence of live/real-time control status displayed on the Trust Center, explicit evidence of certification badges/report listings, evidence the NDA is a click-through flow, independent or hands-on corroboration that it shortens security reviews.
